ec72001c-45fe-45c7-996a-c42de66aa218.quote: A rough Murdock, no argument. Damage per minute ran about a quarter under Goldilocks324's own norm, deaths ran over it, and Sparrow alone dropped him three times, including the opening kill of the last fight. Sting Operation gives him spare Static Traps, so when Sparrow is unseen before a fight or objective, Murdock lays traps on her approach first and only steps up once she has shown.
ec72001c-45fe-45c7-996a-c42de66aa218.issue: 'Sparrow alone dropped him' reads as solo 1v1 catches; kill credit names only the killer, and two of those deaths came in the 2-4 and 1-4 teamfights

ec72001c-45fe-45c7-996a-c42de66aa218.quote: Cuban Noobster's Scarlett was a bloody mess: hero damage under a third of her usual, dead before two of their three Fangtooths. When Fangtooth is under a minute out and any of us is dead, Scarlett calls the pit off and takes a camp or tower elsewhere instead of joining a short-handed contest. She still led our objective damage and took the Riktor kill at Primal Fangtooth.

ec72001c-45fe-45c7-996a-c42de66aa218.quote: Willy Guggenheim's Belica was the one player who turned up armed. Top hero damage on our side, farm well above her usual pace, and kills in two of our three won fights, including the Primal Fangtooth pickoff. That is the standard. Two of her three deaths came after two or more of us were already down in that fight, so once two allies drop, Belica backs off toward tower instead of trading into Ikra or Grux.
